title: 第024章 云梦蝶开始修炼第025章 秦延军当保安
content_zh:
;;
秦延军斩杀完第三只怪物，同云梦蝶手牵手潇洒的离开，这羡慕到了年轻的男女。
这时，之前很是恩爱的一对情侣，在看到秦延军又斩杀了一只怪物，年轻貌美的女子突然对男子说道：“亲爱的，你看看人家多厉害，再看看你是不是没法相比！”
男子说道：“亲爱的，你这话是什么意思？我对你不够好吗？你要什么我都给你买，从来没有不兑现的。现在你看到人家斩杀了怪物，这就看上人家了？你是想要移情别恋吗？清醒一点吧！人家有女人，而且还那么的漂亮！”
女子一听，顿时来了火气：“怎么？吃醋了，还是你看上那位帅哥英雄的女人了？哼！我再也不理你了，你去找别人吧！看人家理不理你？”
男子也火了：“不理就不理，我还不稀罕你了！天天就知道攀比，看到厉害的就心动，我受够了！”
说罢，男子转身就要走。女子见状，一下子慌了神，伸手去拉男子：“你……你真要走啊？我刚刚就是气话，是想让你的上进心强一些，难道我说这话也有错吗？”
男子甩开她的手：“别再拿气话当借口了，我不想再被你这么伤害。”
就在两人拉扯间，一只新的怪物突然从旁边小巷冲了出来，张牙舞爪地扑向人群。女子吓得尖叫一声，下意识躲到了男子身后。
男子虽然害怕，但还是咬牙挡在她面前。秦延军和云梦蝶听到动静回头，秦延军瞬间出手，一道灵力射出，将怪物击退。
他看向这对情侣，摇了摇头道：“别再为了些小事争吵，珍惜眼前人。”
说罢，带着云梦蝶再次潇洒离去。那对情侣望着他们的背影，又对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了愧疚与珍惜。
男子主动认错道：“亲爱的，刚才是我不对，没有明白你对我的期望。从今天开始，我一定要发奋图强，让你过上最好的生活。”
听了这话，女子激动不已，一下子扑进了男子的怀中，后悔的说道：“亲爱的，是我不对，今后我说话一定注意，把表达的事情想清楚再说出来。”
秦延军虽然离开了，但是耳朵非常的灵敏，听到这对年轻情侣互相道歉，心中满足感油然而生。
“梦蝶，今后我一定会好好的保护你，不让你受到任何的伤害。这样吧！为了防止我不在你身边的时候受到伤害，我教你修炼吧！”
云梦蝶一听，顿时来了兴趣。但是，又不知道什么叫修炼，所以一个劲的向秦延军询问。
秦延军耐心地解释道：“修炼就是通过吸收天地灵气，强化自身，让自己拥有超凡的能力。就像我刚刚击退怪物那样。”
云梦蝶眼睛亮晶晶的，满是期待：“那我能学会吗？会不会很难呀？”
秦延军宠溺地摸了摸她的头：“放心，有我教你，肯定没问题。而且你天资聪慧，说不定进步会很快。”

突然，秦延军想到了自己的功法女子不能修炼，于是说道：“梦蝶，我的功法女子不能学，现在我就打电话让大师姐把她的功法给我，然后你就可以修炼了。”
云梦蝶问道：“阿军，大师姐会愿意让我修炼吗？没有你师傅的同意，会不会给她带来麻烦？”
“放心吧！师傅其实是一个很好的人，我在山上的时候，有时会对我拳打脚踢，但是他都是在帮我修炼。要不是师傅他老人家认真的教我，我也不会那么快就能下山。”秦延军说道。
随后，秦延军就打电话给大师姐吴茉莉，电话很快接通。
听筒里传来吴茉莉的声音：“小师弟，这么晚了在哪里？打电话给我，有事情吗？”
秦延军说道：“大师姐，我和梦蝶在江边看夜景呢。”
吴茉莉一听乐了，满意的点点头说道：“小师弟，今天应该是你们第一次去江边玩吧？好好看一下江海的夜景，真的很美妙，很漂亮。”
“唉！大师姐，还看什么夜景呀？今天晚上我都斩杀了四头畜牲，不知道从哪里冒出来的怪物，它们都聚在了一起，幸好有我在，不然那些到江边游玩的人，还不知道有多少人受到伤害！”秦延军道出实情，目的是想要大师姐把功法告诉自己，让女朋友修炼。
吴茉莉听说有怪物，而且还是四只，这可把她吓坏了；要是小师弟有个三长两短，自己该怎么向师傅交代然后关心的问道：“小师弟，你和梦蝶姑娘都没事吧？”
秦延军一听，时机成熟了，试探性的说道：“大师姐，幸好今天有我陪着梦蝶，不然后果不敢设想。”
停顿了一下，补充道：“要是梦蝶也学会了修炼，那该多好，我不在身边的时候，她也能自保！可惜！我的功法女子又不能修炼。”
吴茉莉一听就明白了小师弟的话语，心想，这个小师弟还真是滑头，想要功法又不明说，还要拐弯抹角的，让我自愿交出来，真是服了你，唉！算了，谁叫你是我的小师弟呢？就算师傅怪罪下来，我也认了！于是说道：“小师弟，我这就把功法用手机发给你，让梦蝶姑娘好好的修炼吧！”
没过多久，秦延军的微信提示音响了起来，打开一看，正是吴茉莉发过来自己修炼的功法。“九天玄女诀！”
得到了功法，秦延军带着云梦蝶找了一处安静的地方。
一切准备就绪，秦延军就开始教云梦蝶如何感知灵气。云梦蝶全神贯注地按照秦延军所说的方法去做，可一开始却毫无头绪。她有些沮丧，秦延军鼓励道：“别着急，这需要一个过程。慢慢来，我会一直在你身边。”
在秦延军的不断引导下，云梦蝶终于隐隐约约感受到了那一丝若有若无的灵气，她兴奋地看向秦延军，眼中满是惊喜。秦延军微笑着点头，继续指导她如何吸纳灵气。随着时间的推移，云梦蝶逐渐掌握了吸纳灵气的方法，她的修炼之路，就此开启。

After Qin Yanjun killed the third monster, he and Yun Mengdie left hand in hand and left gracefully, which made the young man and woman envious.
At this time, a couple who had been very affectionate before saw Qin Yanjun kill another monster. The young and beautiful woman suddenly said to the man: "My dear, look at how powerful she is, and see if you can't compare!"
The man said: "My dear, what do you mean? Am I not good enough for you? I will buy you whatever you want, and I will never fail to honor it. Now that you see someone killing monsters, you are attracted to them? Do you want to fall in love with someone else? Wake up! They have women, and they are so beautiful!"
When the woman heard this, she immediately became angry: "What? Are you jealous, or have you fallen in love with that handsome hero's woman? Huh! I won't pay attention to you anymore, you go find someone else! Do you want to see if they pay attention to you?"
The man was also angry: "Ignore you, I don't care about you anymore! I know how to compare myself every day, and I get excited when I see someone powerful. I've had enough!"
After saying that, the man turned around and left. When the woman saw this, she panicked and reached out to pull the man: "You...you really want to leave? I just said it angrily to make you more motivated. Am I wrong to say this?"
The man shook her hand away: "Stop using angry words as an excuse. I don't want to be hurt like this by you again."
While the two were fighting, a new monster suddenly rushed out from the alley next to it and pounced on the crowd with its teeth and claws. The woman screamed in fear and subconsciously hid behind the man.
Although the man was scared, he gritted his teeth and stood in front of her. Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie turned around when they heard the noise. Qin Yanjun took action instantly and shot out a burst of spiritual power to repel the monster.
He looked at the couple, shook his head and said, "Stop arguing over trivial matters. Cherish the people in front of you."
After that, he took Yunmengdie and left in style again. The couple looked at their backs and looked at each other again, seeing guilt and cherishment in each other's eyes.
The man took the initiative to admit his mistake and said: "My dear, it was my fault just now. I didn't understand your expectations of me. From today on, I will work hard to let you live the best life."
After hearing this, the woman was so excited that she threw herself into the man's arms and said regretfully: "My dear, it was my fault. I must pay attention to what I say in the future and think clearly about what I want to express before I say it."
Although Qin Yanjun left, his ears were very sensitive. When he heard the young couple apologize to each other, he felt satisfied in his heart.
"Mengdie, I will definitely protect you from any harm in the future. Let's do this! In order to prevent you from being harmed when I am not around you, I will teach you how to practice!"
When Yun Mengdie heard this, she immediately became interested. However, he didn't know what cultivation was, so he kept asking Qin Yanjun.
Qin Yanjun explained patiently: "Cultivation is to strengthen oneself by absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, so that one can have extraordinary abilities. Just like what I just did when I defeated the monster."
Yun Mengdie's eyes were bright and full of expectation: "Then can I learn it? Will it be difficult?"
Qin Yanjun patted her head lovingly: "Don't worry, you'll be fine if I teach you. And you're talented and smart, so you might make rapid progress."
Suddenly, Qin Yanjun thought that women could not practice his exercises, so he said: "Mengdie, women cannot learn my exercises. Now I will call the senior sister and ask the senior sister to give me her exercises, and then you can practice."
Yun Mengdie asked: "Ajun, will senior sister be willing to let me practice? Without your master's consent, will it bring trouble to her?"
"Don't worry! Master is actually a very good person. When I was on the mountain, he would sometimes punch and kick me, but he was always helping me practice. If Master hadn't taught me seriously, I wouldn't have been so fast.You can go down the mountain. " Qin Yanjun said.
Afterwards, Qin Yanjun called his senior sister Wu Moli, and the call was quickly connected.
Wu Moli's voice came from the receiver: "Junior brother, where are you so late? Call me, is there something wrong? "
Qin Yanjun said: "Sister, Mengdie and I are watching the night view by the river. "
When Wu Moli heard this, she nodded with satisfaction and said, "Junior brother, today should be your first time to play by the river, right? Take a good look at the night view of the river and sea. It is really wonderful and beautiful. "
"well! Senior sister, what else are you looking at at night? I killed four beasts tonight, and monsters appeared out of nowhere. They all gathered together. Fortunately, I was here, otherwise those who went to the riverside to play would not know how many people would have been hurt! "Qin Yanjun told the truth because he wanted his senior sister to tell him the exercises and let his girlfriend practice them.
Wu Moli heard that there were monsters, and there were four of them, which frightened her; if there was something wrong with her junior brother, how should she explain it to her master? Then she asked with concern: "Junior brother, are you and Miss Mengdie okay? "
Upon hearing this, Qin Yanjun realized that the time was ripe and said tentatively: "Senior Sister, it's a good thing that I am with Mengdie today, otherwise I would not dare to imagine the consequences. "
After a pause, he added: "It would be great if Mengdie also learned how to practice, so that she can protect herself when I am not around! pity! Women can’t practice my skills. "
Wu Moli understood what her junior brother said as soon as she heard it, and thought to herself, this junior brother is really naughty. He wants the technique but doesn't explain it clearly, and he also beats around the bush, asking me to hand it over voluntarily. I really admire you, ugh! Forget it, who called you my junior brother? Even if the master blames me, I will admit it! So he said: "Junior brother, I will send the exercises to you on my mobile phone right now, so that Miss Mengdie can practice well! "
Not long after, Qin Yanjun's WeChat notification rang. When he opened it, he saw that it was Wu Moli who had sent her the exercises she had practiced. "Nine Heavens Xuannv Jue! "
After obtaining the skill, Qin Yanjun took Yun Mengdie to find a quiet place.
When everything was ready, Qin Yanjun began to teach Yun Mengdie how to sense spiritual energy. Yun Mengdie concentrated on doing what Qin Yanjun said, but she had no clue at first. She was a little frustrated, Qin Yanjun encouraged: "Don't worry, this needs a process. Take your time, I will always be there for you. "
Under Qin Yanjun's constant guidance, Yun Mengdie finally felt a faint hint of spiritual energy. She looked at Qin Yanjun excitedly, her eyes full of surprise. Qin Yanjun nodded with a smile and continued to instruct her on how to absorb spiritual energy. As time went by, Yunmengdie gradually mastered the method of absorbing spiritual energy, and her path to cultivation began.
